events.detail: Human ratified decomposition A->B->C: A compuerta de salida (latencia, horario, rampa + deuda intervalo drenaje), B cortacircuitos y traspaso, C presentacion y un-mensaje-por-turno (C depends on B). Order A->B->C, each child runs its own full lifecycle with its own Fleet Gate.

Human ratified numeric defaults block (all per-cell env-configurable, 'a calibrar'): latencia minima 3000 ms; drenaje 2000 ms; horario 09:00-19:00 dias 1-5 TZ America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires; rampa 20/dia inicial +20/dia por semana durante 4 semanas, techo permanente; umbral repeticion cortacircuitos 3; palabras de frustracion {humano, persona, agente, operador}.

Human ratified default texts verbatim: identificacion primer turno 'Te atiende un asistente automático. Si preferís hablar con una persona, escribí «humano».'; traspaso 'Te paso con una persona del equipo. En cuanto esté disponible te responde por acá.'; 3 neutral presentation variants with deterministic per-contact selection (no randomness, D-08).

Human ratified the anti-24/7 rule: reject at startup any attention window whose duration exceeds 16 hours. Rationale: adr-0015 discipline must not be deactivatable via configuration; a 24h window would disable the schedule measure de facto.

All three children (HEX-019-a compuerta de salida, HEX-019-b cortacircuitos, HEX-019-c presentacion/turno/centinela) merged to main (25adab7, b4013c9, 09b39ba). RESIDUAL CHAIN DECLARED EMPTY by HEX-019-c's final deep review (PAT-2026-08-11-000000027): A's residual closed by B, B's residual closed by C, C introduced none. The seven adr-0015 Layer-1 measures are complete; docs/STATUS.md entry 'Política anti-ban no desactivable por configuración' closed 2026-08-12. Known documented reading: one-message-per-turn binds sidecar-authored messages only (blueprint reading of AC-3); strict reading remains available as a future task.
